unprofiled.title: Connected, with no health information
unprofiled.body: This number is connected and working. It was set up before GOTCHA could check individual numbers, so there is nothing to report about its health and no repairs to offer. Reconnecting it would enable both.

templatesPaused.fixInMeta: This is fixed in your Meta Business account, not here.

connect.coexistHeading: What happens to a Business app number
connect.migrationNotPossible: Moving it off the Business app entirely is not something anyone can do — it is not a step you have missed.

import.heading: Learning from this number's history
import.live: The number is already live. Everything below happens alongside it and does not hold anything up.
import.whatHappens: While this runs, GOTCHA is learning your language and tone, finding the questions you answer most and the answers you give, and remembering the customers it meets.
import.noOrder: Those happen together rather than one after another, so there is no order to watch.
import.answers: {count, plural, =0 {No answers found yet} one {# answer found} other {# answers found}}
import.notCountedYet: Nothing has been counted yet. The first numbers appear once the history finishes arriving.
import.safeToClose: Safe to close this page — it keeps running.
import.emailOnDone: An email goes to the workspace owners when the report is ready.
import.emailNeedsAddress: That email only goes to owners who have an email address on their account.
import.readyBody: GOTCHA has finished reading. Nothing it learned is in use until you approve it.
import.failedWithStage: It stopped while {stage}. Nothing from this import is in use.
import.failedBare: It stopped before finishing. Nothing from this import is in use.
import.unavailableBody: This number has no history GOTCHA can read — usually because it is new, or because the source declined to share it.

review.heading: What GOTCHA learned
review.nothingUsedYet: None of this is in use. GOTCHA only answers from what you approve here — an answer that is still waiting cannot reach a customer.
review.evidenceNotTruth: These are things your team actually said. That makes them evidence, not policy: an agent may have made an exception once, or been wrong.
review.alreadyCoveredBody: You already have an answer for these, so they were not added a second time. Nothing was turned down.
review.evidence: Said {occurrences, plural, one {once} other {# times}} to {customers, plural, one {one customer} other {# customers}}, {from} to {to}.
review.evidenceNoDates: Said {occurrences, plural, one {once} other {# times}} to {customers, plural, one {one customer} other {# customers}}.
review.liveLookup: Do not let the AI state this as fact. It is true in general and depends on something that changes — stock, a calendar, a price — so the AI is told to check before answering rather than promise.

curation.kept: Kept as your team wrote it.
curation.live_data: Marked as needing a live check.

review.conflict: Your team gave more than one answer to this. Choose or write the right one — GOTCHA will not pick for you.
review.duplicateOf: You already have an answer to this in your knowledge base.
review.bulkSafe: This only takes suggestions with no conflict and enough evidence behind them. The list is worked out here, not on this page, so it cannot approve a conflict however it is pressed.
review.rerunSafe: Looking again updates the counts on these suggestions. It does not ask you about anything you have already rejected.
review.noLanguageShortcut: The design offers to add a missing reply language from here. There is nowhere to add one — GOTCHA stores a single language and answers each customer in their own regardless.
